name: @trading-journal/engine
description: Framework-agnostic position ledger, P&L schema, and weekly-report engine. The ledger/P&L core (money.js, positionEngine.js, pnlSchemas.js, currentR.js, reportTotals.js, dedupe.js, csv.js, normalize.js) has zero runtime dependencies. The PDF renderer additionally depends on pdf-lib + @pdf-lib/fontkit, both portable to Deno Edge Functions via npm: specifiers.
